samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
    <description>A fixed-point subtractor for performing precise arithmetic operations with fixed precision.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point subtraction.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Q">Number of fractional bits in the fixed-point representation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="N">Total number of bits (integer + fractional) used for inputs and outputs.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]">Register to store the result of the subtraction operation.</assign>
        
        // Different Sign Subtraction
        <if condition="a[N-1] == b[N-1]">
            <assign id="res[N-1]" value="a[N-1]">Sign bit remains the same.</assign>
            <assign id="res[N-2:0]" value="(a[N-2:0] - b[N-2:0])">Subtract fractional and integer parts.</assign>
        </else>
        <else>
            <assign id="res[N-1]" value="a[N-1] > b[N-1] ? 1 : 0">Set sign based on comparison.</assign>
            <assign id="res[N-2:0]" value="a[N-2:0] + b[N-2:0]">Add absolute values.</assign>
        </else>
        
        // Handle zero case
        <if condition="res == 0">
            <assign id="res[N-1]" value="0">Explicitly set sign bit to 0 for zero result.</assign>
        </if>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Fixed-point subtraction logic implemented using conditional statements and arithmetic operations.</implementation>
</module>
